newsitem.title: USA: Sun Television CEO and CFO resign.
newsitem.headline: Sun Television CEO and CFO resign.

text.p: Sun Television and Appliances Inc said Tuesday that its president and chief executive, James Copitzky, and its chief financial offer, Steven Martin, have resigned, effective immediately.
The company said Coptizky and Martin left to pursue other interests, but gave no further details.
The announcement came with the company's release of its year-end results, in which it reported a loss of $2.60 a share, compared to a profit of $0.38 a share in fiscal 1996.
The fiscal 1997 results included non-recurring, restructuring charges of $16.7 million.

Sun said R. Carter Pate, a managing partner with Price Waterhouse Business Turnaround Services, who joined Sun in February to oversee the company's turnaround, will assume Copitzky's duties on an interim basis.
It said John Lynch, its controller, will serve as chief financial officer until Martin's successor is found.
